update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.12 - Dating schedule combo preset
Added ----- - Support Card Dating: a one-tap "Add Team Sirius + Heirs to the Throne (staggered)" button adds both cards at once with non-colliding turns. Running both presets unmodified previously meant Team Sirius's turns fully overlapped Heirs to the Throne's, so one card would silently miss every shared date.
